don’t provoke your children

Fathers
don’t provoke your children
so that they won’t be discouraged.
Fathers
do not be hard on your children
so that their spirit may not be broken.

Go away now
and take the fat for your food and the sweet for your drink
and send some to him for whom nothing is made ready: for this day is holy to our Lord: and let there be no grief in your hearts; for the joy of the Lord is your strong place.
